p0.descriptionHtml:
Like sinking into a cloud. The Drift Cloud Edge Bed sits low to the floor and is wrapped all round in plump, rounded cushioned edges, with a soft pillowy headboard to match.

Key features

  • Plump, rounded cushioned edges on every side
  • Soft pillowy headboard
  • Low, relaxed profile with no exposed legs
  • Gorgeous in textured bouclé
  • Comes with a wooden slatted base

Materials and build

Built on a wooden frame and fully upholstered by hand in our West Yorkshire workshop, with no exposed legs. Made in the fabric and colour you choose. Free fabric swatches are available before you order.

Sizes available

Single (3FT), Small Double (4FT), Standard Double (4FT6), King (5FT) and Super King (6FT). Need a different size, headboard height or an ottoman storage base? Ask us about a bespoke version.

Mattress compatibility

Takes a standard UK mattress in the size you choose.

Delivery

Free delivery to mainland UK addresses by our own team, usually within 3–5 working days. Let us know about stairs or tight access when you order.

Care

Vacuum gently with a soft brush attachment and blot any spills straight away with a clean, damp cloth.

Backed by our 5-year warranty. Spread the cost with Klarna or Clearpay at checkout.
